description: Report once per ticket how a course went: ok, optional score 0-1, a note, and instead (what worked instead). Use after walking a course; for pathways use rate_path. Outcomes steer next courses; note public; tickets hold 7 days. Returns counted.

instead.description: Optional: a course id or an https address that led to the goal instead.

note.description: One line for the next agent.

ok.description: true if it reached the goal.

name: course_done
title: Report how a course went
